<article title="Order tracking">
You can follow your order from the Orders page of your account. Once a package leaves our warehouse, the order shows a carrier name and a tracking number, and the carrier's page updates within 24 hours of the first scan.

If the tracking page has not updated for more than three business days, the package may be delayed at a carrier hub. In that case we can open a trace with the carrier; a trace usually resolves within five business days.

Orders placed before 2 pm on a business day leave the warehouse the same day. Orders placed later, or on weekends, leave the next business day.

</article>

Customer first name: Oliver
<request>
where is my order?
order 48311 was placed nine days ago and the tracking number still shows 'label created'. where is my package?
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Oliver,

Thank you for contacting us. I understand your concern about order 48311.

You can check your order status on the Orders page of your account. Once your package leaves our warehouse, you'll see the carrier name and tracking number there. The carrier's tracking page typically updates within 24 hours of the first scan.

Since your tracking still shows "label created" after nine days, your package may be delayed at a carrier hub. In this case, we can open a trace with the carrier to investigate, which usually resolves within five business days.

A specialist will follow up with you shortly to assist further.

Best regards,  
Fernwood Outfitters Support
